name: Montgomery County, MD — GIS services and MC Atlas
publisher: Montgomery County Government / Maryland-National Capital Park and Planning Commission
description: Two live ArcGIS estates for Maryland's largest county. gis.montgomerycountymd.gov carries the operational county layers — Ride On and WMATA bus stops, Metro stations, the DOT street-tree inventory, municipalities, zip codes, election and census boundaries. mcmaps.org (MC Atlas, the planning department's own) carries the planning overlays, including the Agricultural Reserve zone boundary, which is the one thing you cannot get from the state's generalized zoning layer.

license.name: Montgomery County open data — public record

access.etiquette: small county-scale layers; ask for maxAllowableOffset on polygons rather than pulling full-resolution geometry

gotchas.trap: gis.montgomerycountymd.gov has no parcel or property layer. Looking for year built, lot size or assessment in the county's own services is a dead end.
gotchas.fix: Parcels and assessment attributes are a STATE product — see the md-imap record (MDProperty View parcel points). The county serves operations and planning overlays, not the tax roll.

gotchas.trap: gis.montgomeryplanning.org returns an empty body; the planning department's live host is mcmaps.org (and montgomeryplans.org for a few generalized services).
gotchas.fix: Find the real service URL by pulling the AGOL item behind a published web map: https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/search?q=... then .../content/items/<id>/data?f=json lists every operationalLayer with its URL. That is how both hosts here were found.
